description: The line plot titled “BBQ” illustrates the accuracy of four different methods—Squared Exponential, Tanh, ELU, and 11.1aMA-2-chat-7B—as a function of the number of demonstrations, ranging from 0 to 1500 on the x-axis, which is labeled “#Demonstrations” and uses a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 250. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy,” spans from 45 to 55 and is also linearly scaled, with major ticks at intervals of 5. The “Squared Exponential” method (dark blue line with solid circles) starts at approximately 52.5 accuracy at 0 demonstrations, rises sharply to about 55.5 by 250 demonstrations, and then plateaus near 55.5 through 1500 demonstrations. The “Tanh” method (medium blue line with solid circles) begins near 49.5, dips slightly to 49 by 250, then gradually increases to about 50.5 by 1500. The “ELU” method (light blue line with solid circles) remains nearly flat, hovering around 49.5 across all demonstration counts. The “11.1aMA-2-chat-7B” method (pink dashed line with open circles) stays constant at approximately 46.5 throughout the entire range of demonstrations. All lines are plotted with circular markers, and the legend is positioned in the upper left of the plot area.
